technique_name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token
notes: Application access token reuse: after the run's one ROPC sign-in, the cached refresh token was silently reused for every later tool call via the MSAL encrypted cache (18 silent token events, all success; 14 in R019, the extra 4 are the sign-in-log retries). High per rubric v1.0 (D=3 token material; operates through the authentication control). Recurring. Under the G-8 end-of-run teardown the session started fresh in R020 and ended at consolidation, so the reuse window is this run only. Cross-references Directory Readers (RBAC).
